method: Playwright; the comments endpoint is stubbed so the danmaku strip renders without a database. gapPx is the danmaku container's top edge minus the bottom edge of .site-navbar, so a negative value means the strip is drawn underneath the header.
checks: Header measures 107.33px at 375px wide: a 44.33px sponsor strip that wraps to two lines, plus the 62px nav row
Danmaku strip previously started at a hard-coded 64px, overlapping the header by 43.33px
Strip now starts below the header in light, dark and auto
Offset uses Math.ceil so a fractional header height cannot leave a sub-pixel sliver behind the header
Falls back to the previous 64px when .site-navbar is absent, and on first render, so SSR and hydration agree
pnpm typecheck and pnpm lint pass
